categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, research and development, manufacturing, and sales of water-saving valves. Main product categories include butterfly valves, gate valves, control valves, check valves, and other valve products, along with supporting equipment. The company also provides smart water management solutions including intelligent fire hydrants, intelligent pressure reducing valves, and remote monitoring systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a core technology system based on soft sealing technology, hard sealing technology, valve and pipeline protection technology, high-efficiency control technology, and performance simulation testing technology. Manufacturing employs a 'make-to-order' production model with self-developed design, processing, assembly, and testing capabilities. The company utilizes advanced equipment and lean manufacturing management to optimize production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include municipal water supply and drainage systems, water conservancy projects, fire protection systems, smart water management systems, petrochemical industries, and industrial applications. The company serves water utilities, engineering contractors, and industrial enterprises across multiple sectors. Major end markets include urban water infrastructure, water resource management, and industrial fluid control systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Shanghai's Jiading District. It has established approximately 30 regional sales offices across major Chinese cities organized into three business divisions: North China, East China, and South China. The company also has international presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Taiwan, with export sales representing approximately 5% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the valve manufacturing supply chain. It sources raw materials and components from suppliers, manufactures finished valve products, and sells directly to end-users, engineering contractors, and distributors. The company maintains control over design, production, and quality assurance while outsourcing certain low-value-added component manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent valve technology, smart water management systems, and energy-efficient solutions. Key R&D initiatives include developing IoT-enabled smart valves, remote monitoring and control systems, and digital water management platforms. The company collaborates with universities including Hohai University and Harbin Institute of Technology on smart water technology development and has established innovation bases for smart water management.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of valve products and related equipment to end-users and engineering contractors. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and acceptance. The company also generates revenue from installation services, technical guidance, and after-sales support. A small portion comes from equipment rental and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the water-saving valve segment with significant competitive advantages in product quality, technical innovation, and brand recognition. Major competitors include other Chinese valve manufacturers such as Weilong, Nanfang Valve, and Tongdu Fluid. The company differentiates itself through superior sealing technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and strong technical service capabilities. It holds a commanding position in the domestic water-saving valve market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of approximately 914.7 million yuan, representing a 13.47% decline from 2023's 1.057 billion yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 75.9 million yuan in 2024, down 22.98% from 98.5 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 2.706 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue pressure in recent years due to market conditions but maintains a solid financial foundation with positive profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes water-saving and energy-efficient valve solutions that address critical infrastructure needs in urban water systems and industrial applications. Key differentiators include advanced sealing technologies ensuring superior performance and longevity, comprehensive product portfolio meeting diverse application requirements, intelligent monitoring and control capabilities for smart water management, and extensive technical service network providing localized support. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for mission-critical water infrastructure projects.
